mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_daily_mission (user_id, mission_date, mission_id, current_count, is_completed, is_rewarded) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionDate}, #{missionId}, #{currentCount}, #{isCompleted}, #{isRewarded})
mapper.select: SELECT udm.user_id, udm.mission_date, udm.mission_id, udm.current_count, udm.is_completed, udm.is_rewarded, udm.created_at, dm.mission_id as dm_mission_id, dm.title as dm_title, dm.mission_type as dm_mission_type, dm.goal_count as dm_goal_count, dm.reward_exp as dm_reward_exp FROM user_daily_mission udm JOIN daily_mission dm ON udm.mission_id = dm.mission_id WHERE udm.user_id = #{userId} AND udm.mission_date = #{date} ORDER BY udm.is_completed ASC, dm.mission_id ASC
SELECT * FROM user_daily_mission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mission_date = #{date} AND mission_id = #{missionId}
